fact: The Mauritanian Centre for Legal, Political and Social Studies and Research (CMERJES) co-hosted a workshop in Nouakchott on 17-18 July 2025 on legal certainty and procedural justice in the age of AI.
title: Workshop on Innovating the Rule of Law in the Age of AI in Nouakchott, Mauritania
publisher: Max Planck Foundation for International Peace and the Rule of Law
